items.title: Brubeck interviewed by Monk Rowe, 2022
items.q: this thing that you sort of grew up with, with Eugene Wright... my dad trying to keep this band together... within the group there were different sort of stresses. And actually I’d say Gene Wright too, seemed to be very neutral about everything

ctx.x: And I wondered did you, were you privy to any of the discussions, like hardly any bands ever break-up without some drama. So here you have a group that’s basically world famous. What were your observations at that time? Did it make an impression on you as the family, like this thing that you sort of grew up with, with Eugene Wright, this is ending.

Well I think, you know, I could see that there was a lot of stress in my dad trying to keep this band together, you know, like literally like getting everyone to show up and getting everyone to — because after all those years of being on the road there was animosity between people and actually Paul and Dave were always pretty okay, and actually my dad I think with everyone in the group was pretty okay. But within the group there were different sort of stresses. And actually I’d say Gene Wright too, seemed to be…
